# youtrack_user (Data Source)

Looks up a user by login, for example to use it as project leader.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `login` (String) Login of the user.

### Read-Only

- `banned` (Boolean) Whether the user is banned.
- `email` (String) Email address of the user.
- `full_name` (String) Full name of the user.
- `id` (String) Database ID of the user.
- `ring_id` (String) ID of the user in Hub.
